description: This file defines the 'AlwaysSelectedCollectionView' class, a custom collection view implementation for UWP applications that maintains a selected item and provides navigation methods, along with a converter class for data binding.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionView
classes.description: A custom collection view that maintains a current item and supports navigation, designed for UWP XAML applications.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionViewConverter
classes.description: A value converter that wraps an IList into an AlwaysSelectedCollectionView for data binding.

methods.name: MoveCurrentTo
methods.description: Moves the current position to the specified item if it exists in the source collection.

methods.name: MoveCurrentToPosition
methods.description: Moves the current position to the specified index within the collection.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts an IList to an AlwaysSelectedCollectionView for data binding.

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Returns UnsetValue, indicating no conversion back is supported.
